final: WITH g AS (SELECT TrackId, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM PlaylistTrack GROUP BY TrackId), s AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM g), sh AS (SELECT g.TrackId, g.cnt, g.cnt * 1.0 / s.total AS share FROM g CROSS JOIN s WHERE s.total IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM sh WHERE share IS NOT NULL), kept AS (SELECT sh.cnt, sh.share, a.avg_share FROM sh CROSS JOIN a WHERE a.avg_share IS NOT NULL AND sh.share > a.avg_share) SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_track_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_of_share_minus_avg FROM kept
